title: The LLM Proposes, the Executive Disposes: A Self-Verifying Agent Instrument that Dissociates Commitment Drift from Binding Drift in Long-Horizon Agents
title_zh: LLM 提议，Executive 裁决：一种自验证 Agent 仪器，用于区分长程 Agent 中的承诺漂移与绑定漂移
abstract_en: How do you verify a long-horizon agent when its own state and self-reports are exactly what you cannot trust? We present an agent instrument built so that verification is structural rather than post-hoc. A deterministic Executive owns all belief; a language model may only file typed proposals, and a claim is admitted only when a prediction pre-registered before acting is matched against observation by code. Two properties make the instrument a verifier of its own science, not just of the agent: every run invalidates itself when per-organ write-error, render-size, or salted-canary-echo floors are breached (four of the first eight architecture runs were invalidated, each localizing a real defect); and a render-invisible shadow reference compiles the plan the full system would have committed in every ablation cell, so drift metrics are defined even where the mechanism under test has been removed. Using this instrument we report a clean, single-variable result on a failure every long-horizon agent suffers: ablating the commitment mechanism flips goal-abandonment from 0.00 to 1.00 while binding error stays flat at 0.00 (three seeds per cell, up to 394 reference beats per run, every run gated valid). The binding channel, by contrast, does not reappear as per-beat drift when its repair is ablated -- because binding is code-owned, the failure class is structurally absorbed, its only residue appearing one layer upstream as a collapse in hypothesis formation. We report these under full disclosure that task efficacy is null (zero level completions across 52 gated runs on ARC-AGI-3), pre-registered as a structural defeater. The contribution is a verification methodology for agent development and the drift decomposition it makes measurable.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种面向长程 Agent 的结构化验证方法：由确定性的 Executive 掌管全部信念状态，LLM 只能提交带类型的 proposals；任何 claim 只有在行动前预注册的 prediction 被代码与 observation 匹配后才可被接纳。该仪器通过运行级失效门控验证自身实验有效性，例如 per-organ write-error、render-size、salted-canary-echo 等指标越界即判定 run 无效；早期 8 次架构运行中有 4 次被无效化，并定位到真实缺陷。同时，系统引入 render-invisible shadow reference，在各类 ablation 条件下仍编译完整系统本应提交的 plan，从而即使机制被移除也能定义 drift 指标。实验显示，在 ARC-AGI-3 上尽管任务完成率为零，作为预注册的结构性缺陷披露，但该仪器能清晰分解漂移：移除 commitment mechanism 会使 goal-abandonment 从 0.00 升至 1.00，而 binding error 保持 0.00；移除 binding repair 后，binding 问题也不会表现为 per-beat drift，因为 binding 由代码管理，其失败被结构性吸收，只在上游体现为 hypothesis formation 崩塌。论文贡献在于提供一种 Agent 开发验证方法，并使 commitment drift 与 binding drift 的分解可测量。
key_points_zh: 提出 deterministic Executive + LLM typed proposals 架构：Executive 独占信念状态，LLM 仅负责提出候选，claim 必须经预注册 prediction 与 observation 的代码匹配后才能写入。
验证不是事后分析，而是结构内生：当 write-error、render-size、salted-canary-echo 等门控指标低于阈值时，整次运行自动无效化，并能定位真实系统缺陷。
引入 render-invisible shadow reference，使 ablation 条件下也能记录完整系统本应采取的 plan，因此即便被测机制被移除，仍可量化 drift。
核心实验发现：移除 commitment mechanism 会将 goal-abandonment 从 0.00 提升到 1.00，但 binding error 仍为 0.00，说明二者可被解耦测量。
论文坦诚披露任务效能为零：在 ARC-AGI-3 的 52 个有效 runs 中无 level completion，因此贡献主要是验证方法论，而非任务性能提升。

llm_assessment.comment: An interesting structural verification instrument for long-horizon agents, but the evidence is narrow and task efficacy is explicitly weak.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一种有趣的长程智能体结构化验证工具，但证据范围较窄且任务效能明确不足。
